articles.summary: NEW YORK, NY, June 4, 2026 — Royalty Pharma plc (Nasdaq: RPRX) today announced that it will participate in a fireside chat at the Goldman Sachs 47th Annual Global Healthcare Conference on Tuesday, June 9, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. ET.
articles.title: Royalty Pharma to present at the Goldman Sachs 47th Annual Global Healthcare Conference
